## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.3666 (spec 0.3701), screen at the exact 176:220 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://fdn2.gsmarena.com/vv/pics/sonyericsson/se-w395-1.jpg (official image; perspective corrected, watermark cropped off)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://fdn2.gsmarena.com/vv/pics/sonyericsson/se-w395-1.jpg); specs: [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/w395/), [techradar.com](https://www.techradar.com/reviews/phones/mobile-phones/sony-ericsson-w395-587003/review).
